get_supported_models: fetch the list of models supported in the OCP API using the client
get_bulk_materials: fetch the list of bulk materials supported in the OCP API using the client
get_adsorbates: fetch the list of adsorbates supported in the OCP API using the client
submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: submit adsorbate slab relaxation jobs to the OCP API using a specified model
get_relaxation_results: fetch relaxation results for a given system ID from the OCP API
